Record income and expenses in the currency you paid in. OWLI keeps the original amount and converts it to %1$s for your totals and budgets.
Mock Demo uses sample data in PHP only. Sign in to record transactions in other currencies.
Enter an amount greater than zero, with up to two decimals.
Enter an amount to see how it converts.
Live rate not available on this phone
OWLI never estimates a rate. The OWLI server converts an amount only when you save a transaction, using the validated exchange rate for its date, and then shows you the exact rate and %1$s amount.
Last rate confirmed in your account: 1 %1$s = %2$s %3$s, rate date %4$s. Historical, not a current quote.
Record a transaction in another currency
Choose the currency when you add or edit a transaction, and enter the amount exactly as paid (up to 2 decimals).

When it is saved, the OWLI server converts it to %1$s at the reference rate published for the transaction date (or the latest one before it, at most 7 days earlier), from the Frankfurter exchange-rate service.
The rate is stored with 8 decimals and the converted amount is rounded to 2 decimals. Both are shown on the transaction.
Totals and budgets use the converted %1$s amount, so different currencies are never added together.
Changing only the amount keeps the stored rate. Changing the currency or the date gets a new validated rate.
Offline, a transaction is kept on this phone unconverted and is converted when it syncs.
Applied by the OWLI server to transactions in the loaded Activity period. Each rate is valid for its own date only.
